Owner decision 2026-10-18: repoach must be a universal tool, usable by anyone in their own repository. Yoob (GitLab, Python + TypeScript, its own local gate) is the first external user that proves generality, never the spec.

## What

- `SP-UNIVERSAL-REPO` umbrella: 13 measured assumptions with file:line, non-goals, migration of this repo, milestones M0–M8, risks, the universality gauge (`charmbracelet/gum` passes `init` + `review pr --dry-run` in five minutes with no code change).
- Children: INSTALL (wheel install boots without a gateway, state off the checkout), PROJECT-CONFIG (`repoach.toml`, `init` on a foreign repository, spec source), FORGE (protocol with GitHub and GitLab implementations and a conformance suite), PROVIDERS (bring-your-own key by default, gateway optional), GATES (lint/test/gate commands per language), CI-ENTRY (review anywhere with one exit contract, end of the auto-merge race).
- `docs/plans/2026-10-18_yoob-production-plan.md`: the measured production state and gap list the specs cite.
- `docs/tech_debt.md` row 22: unpinned `ruff>=0.5` resolves to 0.17 and flips nine Developer-gate tests red on develop.

## Proof
